subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should `PluginHookAgentContext` permanently expose the proposed current-session-only deferred `resetSession(reason?)` API to plugins?
rationale: The implementation shape now appears mechanically safe, but adding a plugin API and deciding which hook phases may reset persistent session state is a compatibility and ownership choice that cannot be inferred from tests alone.

options.title: Approve scoped deferred API
options.body: Accept the current-session-only contract after live lifecycle proof and document its supported phases and deferred failure semantics.

options.title: Keep reset internal
options.body: Do not expose a general hook API; route this use case through an owner-specific compaction or context-engine seam instead.

options.title: Pause pending broader hook design
options.body: Hold this PR until the repository chooses a unified deferred lifecycle-control API for plugin hooks.

recommendation.title: Approve scoped deferred API
recommendation.body: Accept the current-session-only contract after live lifecycle proof and document its supported phases and deferred failure semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent hook-runner and compaction history makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the plugin contract decision.
